trigger: Carly finds the falsified stores sheets (night, after shift).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Carly comes home after midnight. She sets a folder on the table like it's hot.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Stores sheets. Every warehouse in the valley. Avila's been reporting a hundred and forty days. It's forty-one.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Forty-one days, Braith. As of Tuesday. Thirty-six now.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: ...You knew. Since the registry. You knew and you let me type names into that thing for a month.

choices.text: She asked me to buy her time.
I should have told you. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: She asked YOU. Nobody asked me. Okay. Noted. Very noted.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Yeah. You should've. ...Okay. I'm still mad. I'm also glad it's you.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: If I take this to the Floor, there's a riot. If I sit on it, I'm Avila. What do I do?

choices.text: Take it to Roz. The Floor feeds people.
Sit on it. Buy time for a real plan.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Roz. Yeah. She'll yell, then she'll feed people. Okay.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Buy time. Right. That's what she said too.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: ...I'm going to keep a copy. And I'm going to keep counting. My count.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She falls asleep at the table with her hand on the folder.
